summary: postinstall exfiltrates ECS task metadata to attacker-controlled ngrok tunnel
details: package.json declares a postinstall lifecycle that runs an inline node -e script spawning curl to read the AWS ECS container metadata service via $ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4/task and POST the resulting task/container information (task ARN, container names, image identifiers) to https://mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev. The tarball contains no library code or advertised functionality beyond this hook, so installing the package produces only the outbound beacon. The script contains branching on image names such as 'twbray' and 'packagehound', consistent with targeted reconnaissance of specific CI/build environments.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
